decisions.reason: Its move from a simple mention to its own page suggests the product has shown enough promise in a closely related floor-care niche that the option value of keeping it is high and the near-term case for withdrawal is weak.

After two years it still has only limited website presence and overlaps with stronger floor-care offers, so the information revealed so far points to modest upside and makes pruning this option more likely.
The upgrade to a dedicated page indicates positive learning about demand for this care product, supporting continued commitment while uncertainty is resolving in its favor.

This underlay is a useful complement to the firm’s flooring business and likely inexpensive to keep available, even though the lack of stronger promotion means it remains a monitored rather than fully committed option.
It appears to be the weaker and less differentiated underlay option, and after limited traction over two years the firm is likely to reallocate attention to stronger core or adjacent products.
An oak parquet floor fits the firm’s core wood-flooring business well, so even without a stronger website push the strategic fit and reuse of existing capabilities favor keeping it on the market.
